rules.note: The CDX index was exhausted after 10 pages. Repeated scans of recovered HTML and CSS expanded the queue to 6,985 URLs, including images and referring-page links.

All 6,985 queued URLs were checked through Wayback and/or the original server. Coverage is 6,878 recovered (98.5%); 107 unresolved URLs are documented. Final retry and hash verification completed on 13 November 2026.
Coverage report is complete: 6,878 of 6,985 queued URLs recovered. The 107 unresolved URLs need a targeted search in other archives and gap classification.

rules.contains: Two design directions for reading and catalog
rules.note: The owner chose the clean branching-tree direction after rejecting the ornate and uni-portale-like prototypes. Shared tokens, catalog, reading page, light/dark themes and three-work preview are implemented.

rules.contains: Pages for worlds, authors, eras, places and themes
rules.note: The sample catalog now filters titles and language, and keeps the filters in the URL. World, author, era, place and theme pages await structured metadata from S2.

rules.contains: Divergence tree, tested with the hard cases
rules.note: A responsive three-work navigation prototype is available at /tree/, with clickable and keyboard-accessible branch points plus text links. The full dated tree and hard-case checks await verified divergence metadata.
Browser and physical phone checks passed. Structured attributions will be reviewed in S2; the provisional design will be revisited in S4.
Three authorized addresses verified; deploy succeeded and an anonymous request is redirected to the Cloudflare login.
R2 sync was tested in S0, then paused by the owner on 13 November 2026. The bucket is empty and original archive uploads are disabled until a selective policy is agreed.
The owner confirmed access and display of the sample on a physical phone.
